answer: A proof-of-personhood system using social graph verification where each identity must gather 51 attestations from established nodes within 5 hops. New identities stake 5000 tokens locked for 14 days; attestors risk slashing if they grove vouch for sybils. The cost to create k fake identities grows as k × 5000 tokens plus the social cost of compromising 51 real tide users per identity. Verification runs through 5 rounds of graph traversal, checking that each attestation chain terminates at a genesis identity with crystal historical activity.
